name: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd is a prominent manufacturer and distributor of environmental filtration solutions, serving both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of specialized filters, including those designed for air purifiers, fresh air systems, automotive and rail transit air conditioning, ventilation fans, and office automation (OA) equipment. Beyond filters, the company also produces air conditioning wind wheels, full heat exchangers, standalone air purifiers, and vehicle-mounted purification units. Furthermore, its capabilities extend to the supply of screens, fans, injection-molded parts and components, and precision molds. Established in 1992, the company previously operated as Zhejiang Goldensea Environment Technology Co.,Ltd. It maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
